cohort: The study participants were 249 mothers of infants under 6 months of age, who were long-standing Palestinian refugees residing in the UNRWA Zarqa Camp Health Center in Jordan.
finding: The prevalence of exclusive breastfeeding among infants under 6 months was 38.2% among Palestinian refugees in Jordan, with key predictors including birth order, mode of delivery, labor analgesia, and breastfeeding initiation timing, and breastfed infants experienced fewer acute illnesses.
mod_finding: Mothers who delivered vaginally had significantly higher exclusive breastfeeding rates.
cross-section timing: The study surveyed mothers of infants under 6 months of age.
